author: pgaudet
body:
The paper InterPro cites has as a title "Yeast Integral Membrane Proteins Apq12, Brl1, and Brr6 Form a Complex Important for Regulation of **Membrane** Homeostasis and Nuclear Pore Complex Biogenesis. " 

Maybe [nuclear pore complex assembly](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0051292) would be better ? 

Thanks, Pascale
